sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AS A STRONG MID-LATITUDE PACIFIC JET STREAK CONTINUES NOSING INTO THE PACIFIC COAST...MID/UPPER FLOW ACROSS THE PACIFIC COAST INTO THE ROCKIES WILL REMAIN CYCLONIC THROUGH THIS FORECAST PERIOD. UPPER TROUGHING ALREADY INLAND ACROSS THE INTERMOUNTAIN WEST IS EXPECTED TO SHIFT ACROSS THE ROCKIES INTO THE PLAINS TODAY...BUT MODELS SUGGEST THE LARGER SCALE REGIME WILL REMAIN BROADLY ANTICYCLONIC ACROSS THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL TIER STATES...EAST OF THE ROCKIES INTO THE ATLANTIC SEABOARD...AS SUBTROPICAL RIDGING TO THE SOUTH HOLDS FIRM. PERHAPS AIDED BY FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE EASTWARD PROGRESSION OF AN IMPULSE WITHIN THE MAIN WESTERLIES...ACROSS EASTERN CANADA...GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT A CYCLONIC VORTICITY CENTER ...WITHIN WEAK FLOW TO THE NORTH OF THE SUBTROPICAL RIDGE...MAY ACCELERATE EAST OF THE NORTH CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...THROUGH SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND/NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS. MEANWHILE...AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE...ALREADY ASSOCIATED WITH CONSIDERABLE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OVER THE MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY...LIKELY WILL PROGRESS SLOWLY EASTWARD THROUGH PARTS OF THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI AND LOWER OHIO VALLEYS BY LATE TONIGHT. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH VE

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS INTO PARTS OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: THE TENDENCY FOR THE CONTINUING NORTHEASTWARD ADVECTION OF STRONGER CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR IS CONTRIBUTING TO AN UNCERTAIN CONVECTIVE FORECAST...AND A BROAD BRUSH OF SLIGHT RISK SEVERE PROBABILITIES ACROSS THE REGION. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES ARE MORE THAN SUPPORTIVE OF SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL...AND SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO CONTRIBUTE TO ORGANIZED CLUSTERS...PERHAPS AREAS WITH ISOLATED SUPERCELLS. FURTHER UPSCALE GROWTH AND INTENSIFICATION APPEARS POSSIBLE WITH THE CONVECTION NOW PROGRESSING EAST OF THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY. THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS DESTABILIZING WITH HEATING AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...BUT MID-LEVEL WARMING MAY ALSO BE CONTRIBUTING TO INCREASING INHIBITION. AT LEAST LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS ARE ALREADY OCCURRING ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN IOWA...AND ANY FURTHER INTENSIFICATION WOULD LIKELY YIELD ADDITIONAL COLD POOL STRENGTHENING...AND A BROADER SCALE DAMAGING WIND THREAT. OTHER STORMS AND STORM CLUSTERS PROBABLY WILL DEVELOP TO THE WEST AND NORTHWEST OF THIS ACTIVITY...WHERE LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION BECOMES ENHANCED ON THE EDGE OF STRONGER CAPPING LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT. LOCATION REMAINS A BIT UNCERTAIN...BUT HIGHEST PROBABILITIES SEEM T

sections.title: NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC STATES INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: INSTABILITY ASSOCIATED WITH STEEPER LAPSE RATES ACCOMPANYING THE WEAK MID-LEVEL COLD POOL SHIFTING EAST OF THE NORTH CENTRAL APPALACHIANS WILL ENHANCE CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON. THE ENVIRONMENT MAY STILL BE SOMEWHAT MARGINAL FOR SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT...BUT IF FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER IMPULSE CAN SUPPORT STORM CONSOLIDATION...ANY ASSOCIATED COLD POOL MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AN IMPULSE EMBEDDED WITHIN MODEST CYCLONIC FLOW...NOW SHIFTING ACROSS THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES...COULD SUPPORT CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT EAST OF THE LEE SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY A DEEP MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF AT LEAST STRONG WIND GUSTS...ENHANCED BY THE DOWNWARD MIXING OF HIGHER MOMENTUM ASSOCIATED WITH A 30-50 KT SOUTHERLY 850 MB JET THIS EVENING. ..KERR/GOSS.. 06/24/2013

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE MIDWEST
sections.text: HIGHEST SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES EXIST NEAR-TERM WITH MCS CURRENTLY SHIFTING EWD ACROSS ERN IA. SEE LATEST MESOSCALE AND WW DISCUSSIONS FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...OVERTURNING AND RESIDUAL COLD POOL SHOULD SUBDUE SEVERE POTENTIAL SOMEWHAT OVER THE MID-MO VALLEY TONIGHT. WILL MAINTAIN A BROAD BRUSH OF SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES FOR DEVELOPING HIGH PLAINS CONVECTION THAT MAY PRODUCE ISOLATED SEVERE WELL INTO THE EVENING. A STRENGTHENING LLJ OVER THE CNTRL PLAINS COULD SUPPORT A CLUSTER OR TWO EVOLVING WITHIN THE WAA REGIME ALONG/N OF CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW IN PARTS OF NEB.

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: NUMEROUS TSTMS WILL POSE A RISK FOR LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINAL HAIL...AS WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR REMAINS THE LIMITING FACTOR TO A MORE ROBUST THREAT. SEE LATEST MESOSCALE AND WW DISCUSSIONS FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: NO APPRECIABLE CHANGE FROM PREVIOUS DISCUSSION. ..GRAMS.. 06/24/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1122 AM CDT MON JUN 24 2013/

sections.title: OH VALLEY/SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A VERY WELL-ORGANIZED LINEAR MCS IS MOVING QUICKLY EWD ACROSS NRN IND AND EXTENDS SWWD INTO ERN IL. SFC DEWPOINTS AHEAD OF THE LINE ARE IN THE UPPER 60S AND LOWER 70S F WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...A PRONOUNCED 700 MB JET OF 50 TO 65 KT IS LOCATED JUST BEHIND THE BOWING CONVECTIVE SYSTEM. THIS ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY SHOULD SUPPORT THE MCS FOR A FEW MORE HOURS...MOVING INTO NRN AND CNTRL OH. A FORWARD SPEED OF 50 KT ALONG WITH LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES GREATER THAN 7.5 C/KM SHOULD MAKE THE LINE VERY EFFICIENT AT PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. HAVE ADDED A 30 PERCENT WIND DAMAGE PROBABILITY CONTOUR ACROSS NRN IND AND NW OH. THE MAIN QUESTION IS...HOW FAR CAN THE LINE MCS GO TO THE EAST. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT INSTABILITY DROPS OFF ACROSS FAR ERN OH INTO WRN PA WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE ONLY IN THE LOWER 60S F. THE LINE COULD BE MAINTAINED INTO THIS AREA BUT MAY WEAKEN ACROSS WRN PA. FOR THIS REASON...HAVE EXTENDING THE SLIGHT RISK LINE ALMOST TO THE OH-PA STATE-LINE.

sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SOUTHWEST FLOW IS IN PLACE ACROSS THE NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHING THE REGION FROM THE SOUTHWEST. AT THE SFC...A MOIST AXIS EXTENDS FROM CNTRL SD NWWD INTO ERN MT ALONG WHICH WINDS ARE BACKED TO THE SOUTHEAST AND DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID TO UPPER 60S F. ALONG THIS CORRIDOR...MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED AT 2500 TO 3500 J/KG AND REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOW 30 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXCEEDING 8.0 C/KM SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. THE GREATEST SUPERCELL THREAT SHOULD EXIST ACROSS NERN MT TO THE NORTHWEST OF A POCKET OF STRONG INSTABILITY WHERE A 2 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY HAS BEEN ADDED. THE POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS MAY ALSO BE ENHANCED ACROSS CNTRL AND NRN NEB WHICH IS ALSO CO-LOCATED WITH A POCKET OF STRONG INSTABILITY. THE SEVERE THREAT IN NEB AND NWD INTO THE DAKOTAS WILL DEPEND UPON STORM COVERAGE. ALTHOUGH SHORT-TERM MODELS DIFFER ON HOW MANY STORMS WILL INITIATE...THE WRF-HRRR SUGGESTS THAT STORMS WILL CONGEAL INTO SEVERAL LINE SEGMENTS THIS EVENING. ANY LINE OR CLUSTER THAT CAN ORGANIZE SHOULD HAVE A WIND DAMAGE THREAT.

sections.title: SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS IS ONGOING IN SW KS ALONG A NARROW AXIS OF STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 2500 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. THIS CONVECTION IS BEING SUPPORTED BY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE SRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. REGIONAL PROFILERS SUGGEST THAT 0-6 KM SHEAR IS AROUND 40 KT ACROSS MUCH OF THE SRN AND CNTRL PLAINS WHICH COMBINED WITH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.5 C/KM SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. IN ADDITION...TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS EXCEED 30 DEGREES F ACROSS MUCH THE REGION SUGGESTING THAT DOWNDRAFT SPEEDS COULD BE ENHANCED. HOWEVER...STORM COVERAGE REMAINS RELATIVELY ISOLATED LARGELY DUE TO WARM AIR AT MID-LEVELS. THIS SHOULD KEEP THE SEVERE THREAT CONFINED TO AREAS WHERE THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY IS PRESENT. ..BROYLES.. 06/25/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW ISOLD BOUTS OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND A MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THREAT MAY BECOME AN INCREASING CONCERN OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...WITH A DECAYING AREA OF STORMS OVER NRN IL WITH AN ASSOCIATED MCV NEAR THE IL/IA/WI BORDER. STORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED OVER E-CNTRL IA TO THE N OF A COMPOSITE SLOW NWD MOVING BAROCLINIC ZONE/OUTFLOW FROM THE EARLY MORNING ACTIVITY. THE MORE ROBUST STORM THREAT HOWEVER IS ANTICIPATED TO BE WITH A LINEAR CLUSTER OF STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS EXTENDING FROM SWRN IA INTO NERN KS. BUOYANCY WILL REMAIN HIGHEST TO THE S AND INVOF THE BOUNDARY DRAPED ACROSS SRN IA...PROBABLY RESULTING IN A DECREASING SEVERE THREAT WITH STORMS FROM I-80 NWD. A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAXIMUM IS FORECAST TO MOVE ACROSS IA DURING THE DAY...WHICH IS PARTLY RESPONSIBLE FOR ONGOING INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS NEAR THE MO RIVER. A 60 KT WIND GUST WAS OBSERVED AT 15Z AT KOMA...AND OTHER STORMS MAY POSSIBLY INTENSIFY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES. AS A RESULT...ISOLD STRONG-LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL ARE POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY WITH THE STRONGER CORES AS THEY MOVE EWD ACROSS SWRN IA AND NRN MO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CONCENTRATION OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS CAPABLE OF ISOLD WIND DAMAGE WILL OCCUR COINCIDENT WITH A BOWING LINE SEGMENT AS IT MOVES EWD ACROSS CNTRL IA DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: KDMX 0.5 DEG VELOCITY DATA SHOWS A WELL-ESTABLISHED REAR INFLOW JET ALONG AND N OF THE I-80 CORRIDOR IN W-CNTRL IA. THE AIRMASS IS GRADUALLY RECOVERING AHEAD OF THE ENEWD MOVING BOWING LINE SEGMENT /STORM MOTION 240 DEG AT 48 KT/ WITH TEMPS RISING INTO THE MID-UPPER 70S WITHIN A MOIST AND INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. THE SYSTEM MOTION N OF I-80 IS LARGELY ALIGNED WITH THE STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FLOW FIELDS...WHICH WILL PROBABLY AID IN MOMENTUM TRANSFER TO THE SURFACE IN THE FORM OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS. LATEST THINKING IS A CORRIDOR OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL APPROACH THE I-35 CORRIDOR OVER THE NEXT HR WITH AN ACCOMPANYING WIND DAMAGE THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL GRADUALLY MOVE TOWARDS THE I-95 CORRIDOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS/SHENANDOAH VALLEY. A MID-LEVEL IMPULSE AND ASSOCIATED COLD POCKET /-13 DEG C H5/ WILL ACT TO PROVIDE SOME LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION THIS AFTERNOON. AHEAD OF THE EWD MOVING STORMS...SURFACE CONDITIONS OVER THE I-95 CORRIDOR HAVE WARMED TO NEAR 90 DEG WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S...YIELDING MODERATE BUOYANCY /1400 J/KG MLCAPE/ WHEN MODIFYING THE 12Z IAD AND APG RAOBS. ALTHOUGH 0-6 KM VERTICAL SHEAR REMAINS MODEST /20-30 KTS/...MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL /ESPECIALLY IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE PA MID-LEVEL COLD POCKET/ AND A FEW POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE MOST INTENSE CORES. IF STORMS CAN CONGEAL AND COLD POOL CONGLOMERATION OCCURS...PERHAPS THE LOCALIZED SEVERE THREAT WOULD POTENTIALLY LEAD TO A LOOSE CONCENTRATION OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND REPORTS AND PROMPT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF WW 354. AS THREAT SPREADS GRADUALLY EWD...NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NRN IL AND POSSIBLY INTO SRN WI/NWRN INDIANA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS A BAND OF STRONG/LOCALLY SEVERE STORMS CROSSING SERN IA AND ADJACENT NERN MO ATTM...ALONG AN INSTABILITY GRADIENT ON THE NRN FRINGE OF A MODERATE CAPE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS MO/SRN AND WRN IL. WITH AMPLE SHEAR INDICATED OVER THE AREA AND A MESOLOW EVIDENT -- NOW CROSSING CENTRAL IA...EXPECT STORMS TO REMAIN AT LEAST LOOSELY ORGANIZED IN AN ARC-SHAPED BAND AS THEY SPREAD EWD AT AROUND 40 KT TOWARD THE MS VALLEY. WHILE THREATS FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL CONTINUE ACROSS THE WW AREA...EXPANSION OF THIS POTENTIAL EWD/NEWD WITH TIME WILL LIKELY REQUIRE NEW WW ISSUANCE IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. ..GOSS.. 06/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION -- AND ASSOCIATED SEVERE POTENTIAL -- WILL SLOWLY INCREASE ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS VICINITY. WW MAY EVENTUALLY BE REQUIRED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS MOISTENING/IMPLIED ASCENT SPREADING EWD INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS ATTM...AHEAD OF A WEAK SHORT-WAVE TROUGH CROSSING WRN WY/WRN CO. VISIBLE IMAGERY REVEALS SOME CONVECTIVE RESPONSE TO THE ASCENT...WITH CU INCREASING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WY AND NOW OVER THE BLACK HILLS. SHEAR REMAINS GENERALLY WEAK ACROSS THIS AREA...AND SHOULD FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. THIS COMBINED WITH BACKGROUND CAPPING SUGGESTS THAT STORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED OVER THE LOWER TERRAIN...AND THUS OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IS FORECAST TO REMAIN LIMITED. STILL...WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGESTIVE OF BRIEFLY STRONGER UPDRAFTS...POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS MAY OCCUR WITH A FEW OF THE STRONGER STORMS. SHOULD COVERAGE OF THE STRONGER CONVECTION WARRANT...WW COULD EVENTUALLY BECOME NECESSARY OVER PARTS OF THIS AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PERHAPS A FEW POCKETS OF MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCTD PULSE TSTMS CONTINUE TO MOVE IN A GENERAL EWD DIRECTION FROM CNTRL-SRN NY NWD INTO VT. THIS LOCALLY STRONG CONVECTION IS AHEAD OF A MID-LEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM/COLD POCKET OVER NERN PA THAT IS FORECAST TO MOVE TOWARDS THE LOWER HUDSON VALLEY THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. KENX VWP DATA SHOWS WEAK WLY FLOW THROUGH 9 KM /LESS THAN 20 KT/...WHICH IS RESULTING IN DISORGANIZED PULSING TSTMS. STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WOULD AT LEAST LEND THE POSSIBILITY FOR PERHAPS A FEW INSTANCES OF MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE IN POCKETS AS THE ACTIVITY GRADUALLY MOVES EWD THROUGH SRN NEW ENGLAND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD HAIL/WIND DAMAGE THREAT WILL PERSIST FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS...BUT BECOME INCREASINGLY CONFINED TO AREAS VOID OF PRIOR STORMS/OUTFLOW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MID-LEVEL TROUGH/COLD POCKET CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS ERN PA TOWARDS THE MOUTH OF THE HUDSON RIVER. SLIGHTLY STRONGER WLY MID-LEVEL FLOW /30 KT AT 6 KM/ MOVING THROUGH THE BASE OF THE TROUGH OVER THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION /REFERENCE KLWX VWP/ WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG-LOCALLY SEVERE MULTICELLULAR STORMS. SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING OVER PARTS OF FAR SERN PA AND CNTRL NJ WILL LIKELY HINDER A CONTINUATION OF AN APPRECIABLE SEVERE THREAT IN THOSE AREAS FROM HERE FORWARD IN TIME. LIKEWISE...ISOLD SEVERE THREAT WILL PROBABLY DIMINISH WEST TO EAST ACROSS ADJACENT MD/NRN VA AS A CLUSTER OF STORMS AND ASSOCIATED COLD POOLS GRADUALLY MOVE EWD TOWARDS CHESAPEAKE BAY OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. FARTHER N OVER NERN PA AND NRN NJ...A RELATIVELY PRISTINE/UNCONTAMINATED AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL SUPPORT AT SOME POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE HAIL/WIND AS STORMS --IN PROXIMITY TO THE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE-- MOVE EWD TOWARDS THE NYC-NRN NJ MEGALOPOLIS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..SMITH.. 06/24/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SURFACE-BASED CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH A CONDITIONAL ISOLD LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT POSSIBLE IN THE 22-04Z PERIOD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A CU FIELD OVER THE NWRN QUADRANT OF THE TX PANHANDLE TO THE S OF AN AREA OF MID-LEVEL CONVECTION MOVING NEWD INTO SWRN KS. SURFACE TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID 90S TO THE E/SE OF THIS CU FIELD WITH LOW LEVEL CONFLUENCE MAXIMIZED WITHIN A LEE TROUGH/CORRIDOR FROM SWRN KS INTO THE NWRN TX PANHANDLE. STRONG HIGH LEVEL FLOW /45-50 KT AT 8 KM AGL PER KAMA VWP/ WOULD SUPPORT SOME STORM ORGANIZATION AS UPDRAFTS MOVE FARTHER E INTO GREATER MOISTURE. IF/ONCE SCTD STORM INITIATION APPEARS IMMINENT...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL PROBABLY BE REQUIRED TO ADDRESS LARGE HAIL/SEVERE WIND GUST POTENTIAL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO SPREAD NEWD ACROSS WRN/CNTRL KS AND SWRN/S-CNTRL NEB THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. A FEW MAY BE SEVERE...POSING A LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 22Z...A DRYLINE WAS LOCATED OVER FAR WRN KS...WITH A STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING SEWD FROM WRN/SWRN NEB INTO N-CNTRL KS. A HOT WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AIRMASS RESIDES INVOF THE DRYLINE...WHILE LOW 90S AND DEWPOINTS IN LOW TO MID 60S WERE LOCATED E OF THE DRYLINE ACROSS MUCH OF KS. A WEAK UPPER DISTURBANCE IS CURRENTLY APPROACHING WRN KS...AND IS ALSO ASSOCIATED WITH A BELT OF 40 KT MIDLEVEL SWLY FLOW. STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION COMBINED WITH INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL FAVOR ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS EVOLVING ALONG AND E OF THE DRYLINE OVER WRN/CNTRL KS AND SWRN/S-CNTRL NEB THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-2500 J/KG...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FROM 30-40 KT WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS...WHICH WILL POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR MCS CONTINUES ACROSS NE IL WITH CONTINUED SVR WINDS...SOME POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT...EXPECTED. SVR THREAT WITHIN THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD ACROSS SRN LK MI AND INTO SWRN LWR MI/NRN IND. AS A RESULT...A DOWNSTREAM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SVR MCS CONTINUES EWD INTO NE IL /INCLUDING THE CHICAGO METRO AREA/. ESTIMATED MOTION BASED ON RADAR IS 270/49 KT. STRONG TO SVR WINDS HAVE BEEN MEASURED ALONG MUCH OF THE LINE DURING THE PAST HOURS. BASED ON RADAR IMAGERY...THE NORTHERN PORTION OF THE LINE HAS RECENTLY SURGED EWD...SUGGESTING THE SVR WINDS /SOME POSSIBLE SIGNIFICANT/ SHOULD CONTINUE. THE REAR INFLOW JET WAS SAMPLED WELL BY DVN VAD WITH A LARGE AREA OF FLOW GREATER THAN 50 KT BETWEEN 3 AND 6 KM. RADAR IMAGERY HAS ALSO SHOWN WEAKENING ECHOS IN THE WAKE OF THE LINE...FURTHER CONFIRMING THE PRESENCE OF A WELL-DEVELOPED REAR INFLOW JET. AREA DOWNSTREAM OF THE CURRENT LINE ACROSS NRN IND/SRN LWR MI IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 80S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 60S. CURRENT INDICATIONS FROM VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND MESOANALYSIS ARE THAT THE AREA IS WEAKLY CAPPED WITH ONLY MODEST INSTABILITY /MLCAPE AROUND 1000 J PER KG/. HOWEVER...THE STRENGTH OF THE MCS AND THE PRESENCE OF GOOD LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD FAVOR CONTINUED PROPAGATION INTO THIS AREA. AS SUCH...A DOWNSTREAM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE NRN NEB PANHANDLE AND SWRN SD ARE SHOWING SOME SIGNS OF GROWING UPSCALE. THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL SPREAD EWD AS ACTIVITY CONTINUES TO MOVE ACROSS NWRN NEB AND SWRN SD. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2330Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS OVER THE NRN NEB PANHANDLE AND SWRN SD BEGINNING TO MERGE AND GROW UPSCALE. GIVEN TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS ARE NEAR 30F IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER...COLD POOL STRENGTHENING IS LIKELY AS MERGERS CONTINUE TO TAKE PLACE...WHICH WILL AID IN MOVING THIS SMALL MCS DOWNSHEAR ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF NWRN NEB AND SWRN SD. RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL EXIST. WW DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE IMMEDIATELY NECESSARY...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINE OF TSTMS MOVING INTO UPSTATE NY/NRN VT ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE A DIMINISHING TREND WITH LIMITED SVR WIND POTENTIAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF TSTMS RECENTLY CROSSED FROM ONTARIO INTO UPSTATE NY/NRN VT WITH THE NRN PORTION OF THE LINE ALSO MOVING INTO NRN/WRN ME. RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THE OVERALL STRENGTH OF THE LINE HAS BEEN WEAKENING WITH REFLECTIVITY AT BOTH 5 KM AND 9 KM CAPPI DECREASING. KCXX RADAR IMAGERY ALSO SHOWS THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS PUSHED WELL AHEAD OF THE CNTRL PORTIONS OF THE LINE. STRONGEST CELL APPEARS TO BE JUST ACROSS THE BORDER IN WRN ME...MOVING SE IN SOMERSET COUNTY IN WRN ME. SHEAR PROFILES ARE RELATIVELY WEAK AND INSTABILITY IS WANING AS DAYTIME HEATING ENDS. WHILE SOME ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL ARE POSSIBLE...PARTICULARLY ACROSS A NRN/WRN ME...AN OVERALL WEAKENING TREND IS ANTICIPATED AND A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE OVER PORTIONS OF N-CNTRL AND ERN MT THIS EVENING...WITH UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS POSSIBLE TONIGHT. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS...BUT A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE ALSO POSSIBLE. WW MAY NEED TO BE ISSUED DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EVENING MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A TROUGH OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE WAS LOCATED OVER CNTRL MT...WITH A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM N-CNTRL MT INTO NERN WY. LOW-LEVEL ELY FLOW IS MAINTAINING A RATHER MOIST AIRMASS OVER THE ERN HALF OF THE STATE...WITH DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM 55-65F. THIS MOISTURE COMBINED WITH A WARM BOUNDARY LAYER AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IS AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES FROM ROUGHLY 1000-2500 J/KG. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE BEGINNING TO EVOLVE OFF OF THE STATIONARY FRONT AND ELEVATED TERRAIN AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT INCREASES AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH PIVOTING NEWD INTO THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN W. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF LOW-LEVEL ELY FLOW VEERING TO 30-40 KT OUT OF THE SW IN THE MIDLEVELS...SUPERCELLS WILL BE LIKELY WITH INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT...AND WILL POSE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS MAY TAKE PLACE LATER TONIGHT...WITH MCS MAINTENANCE ENHANCED BY STRONG LOW-LEVEL ELY INFLOW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BOWING MCS WITH A HISTORY OF PRODUCING LONG SWATHS OF DAMAGING WINDS CONTINUES TO MOVE E ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST AT 30-40 KT. SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FOR WW 358 IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE...WITH A NEW WW ISSUANCE POSSIBLE OVER SERN LOWER MI INTO NRN PORTIONS OF OH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FAST MOVING BOW ECHO WAS LOCATED FROM SWRN LOWER MI INTO NRN/CNTRL IN AND FAR E-CNTRL IL AT 01Z. AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM /PER ILN AND DTX 00Z RAOBS/ IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S...AND DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 60S...WHICH SUPPORTS MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-1500 J/KG. THOUGH THE BOW ECHO HAS SHOWN A WEAKENING TREND DURING THE LAST HOUR...ELONGATION OF THE COLD POOL DOWNSTREAM INTO THE MODERATE INSTABILITY ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO FAVOR UPDRAFT REGENERATION ALONG THE GUST FRONT AND MAINTAIN A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS. AREAS OF E OF WW 358 WILL BE MONITORED FOR A NEW WW ISSUANCE. ..GARNER.. 06/25/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SHORT-TERM SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FOR WW 357 IS OVER PORTIONS OF SWRN/S-CNTRL KS. CANCELLATION OF WW MAY BE WARRANTED FROM WRN KS INTO S-CNTRL NEB GIVEN A RAPIDLY STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0215Z...SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WAS ONGOING APROX 30 NM ESE OF DDC IN SWRN KS. VWP FROM THE DODGE CITY AND WICHITA RADAR SHOW FAVORABLE WIND PROFILES ARE IN PLACE FOR SUPERCELLS...WITH A 30-40 KT LOW-LEVEL JET CONTRIBUTING TO LARGE HODOGRAPH CURVATURE. THUS...THE STORM ESE OF DDC MAY CONTINUE TO POSE A LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND THREAT DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. HOWEVER...THE BOUNDARY LAYER IS COOLING AND CINH IS INCREASING RAPIDLY ACROSS THE AREA...WHICH SHOULD AID IN WEAKENING THE ONGOING STORM IN SWRN KS...AND LIKELY PRECLUDE ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT FROM WRN KS INTO S-CNTRL NEB. THIS MAY WARRANT CANCELLATION OF WW 357 FOR MUCH OF THE AREA. ..GARNER.. 06/25/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE ORGANIZING INTO A LINE OVER N-CNTRL MT...AND ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE EWD INTO NERN MT DURING THE NIGHT. THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL CONTINUES FOR WW 359.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0340Z...A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS WITH EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES WAS LOCATED FROM 80 NW OF GGW TO 45 E OF LWT...WITH RADAR ESTIMATED MOTION TOWARD THE E AT 25 KT. AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE LINE IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE 70S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S...WHICH IS AIDING IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS OVER NERN MT. IN ADDITION...SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND VWP FROM GGW SHOW ESELY FLOW IS PRESENT OVER THE LOWEST 2 KM AGL. THE COMBINED ELY MOTION OF THE LINEAR MCS AND UNSTABLE INFLOW LOCATED DOWNSHEAR WILL SUPPORT FORWARD PROPAGATION INTO NERN MT DURING THE NIGHT. PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT GIVEN THE LINEAR MODE OF CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO BE DAMAGING WINDS...THOUGH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL REMAINS POSSIBLE AS WELL. ..GARNER.. 06/25/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS EAST CENTRAL/NERN MT COULD PROVE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW ADDITIONAL STRONG-SVR STORMS THROUGH 08Z...MAINLY OVER NERN MT. HOWEVER...OVERALL TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST THE THREAT FOR FURTHER STORM ORGANIZATION SHOULD CONTINUE TO WANE. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT WW 359 CAN EXPIRE AT 08Z AS SCHEDULED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST TRENDS IN OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWED WEAKENING INSTABILITY OVER ERN MT...THOUGH MUCAPE REMAINED FROM 1500-2500 J/KG IN THE ERN HALF OF WW 359. REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY AT 0645Z SHOWED TWO CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES LOCATED E OF THE REMAINING TSTM ACTIVITY...WITH THE SRN OUTFLOW NOW WELL REMOVED FROM THE STORMS IN PETROLEUM AND WRN GARFIELD COUNTIES. SYNOPTIC TRENDS FOR THE NRN HIGH PLAINS INDICATE THAT 500-700 MB WINDS SHOULD BACK TO SLY OVER ERN MT...WHILE 850 MB WINDS VEER TO SLY WITH DEEP LAYER SHEAR VECTORS BECOMING MORE ORIENTED FROM S-N. DIFFLUENT MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW WILL INCREASE OVERNIGHT AS THE NEGATIVELY-TILTED NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST TROUGH SHIFTS EWD. GIVEN THE EWD DISPLACEMENT OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM THE ONGOING TSTMS...THE OVERALL SVR WEATHER THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO WANE. HOWEVER...CONVECTION WITH EMBEDDED TSTMS COULD PERSIST AFTER WW 359 EXPIRES AS SLY LOW LEVEL WINDS RESULT IN ISENTROPIC ASCENT N OF THE NE-SW OR E-W ORIENTED PORTIONS OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. ..PETERS.. 06/25/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH A BOWING LINE OF STORMS MOVING INTO FAR SERN WI...WITH A SIMILAR THREAT INTO PARTS OF FAR NRN AND NERN IL THROUGH 09-10Z. CONFIDENCE IS GREATER FOR A FEW SVR WIND GUSTS IN FAR SERN WI...BUT OVERALL SPATIAL THREAT IS TOO SMALL TO WARRANT A SVR TSTM WATCH. THE SWRN EXTENSION OF THE LINE INTO NRN IL IS MOVING A LITTLE SLOWER WITH LOWER CONFIDENCE IN HAVING A SVR WIND GUST INTO NERN IL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0720Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A BOWING LINE OF STORMS MOVING THROUGH SERN WI AND RECENTLY MOVED INTO FAR NERN IL. THE SERN WI PORTION OF THIS LINE HAS SHOWN A TENDENCY TO BOW AND WAS MOVING EWD AT 40-45 KT...WHILE THE TRAILING PORTION OF THE LINE IN NRN IL WAS TRACKING ESEWD AT 30-35 KT. A 45 KT SWLY LLJ EXTENDED INTO NRN IL AND SHOULD VEER TO WLY OVERNIGHT. WAA WITHIN THE NOSE OF THIS JET WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT...MAINLY ALONG THE TRAILING LINE OF STORMS WHERE THE ENVIRONMENT IS MODERATELY UNSTABLE /MUCAPE 1000-1500 J PER KG/. IF THE FORWARD SPEED SHOWS SIGNS OF INCREASING...THEN A WW MAY BE NEEDED FOR PARTS OF NERN IL INTO NWRN IND. FARTHER NE OVER SWRN LOWER MI...THE ENVIRONMENT IS MORE STABLE AND FORECAST TO REMAIN STABLE THROUGH 12Z. THUS...THE SERN WI PORTION OF THIS LINE OF STORMS SHOULD NOT POSE A SVR WEATHER THREAT ONCE IT CROSSES SRN LAKE MICHIGAN...THOUGH TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
